description: Use this when the user wants a seating chart or seating plan: a classroom seating chart for students (rows, pairs or groups of 4; keep two students apart; seat some students near the front; mixed groups; a new random seating chart each week that avoids last week's neighbours) or a wedding, party or banquet seating chart (round or long tables of N, keep couples and households together, keep two guests apart, head table, kids table). Accepts typed names or an uploaded roster or guest list (CSV/Excel). It checks each hard rule and reports any conflict, naming the rules that cannot all hold together. Returns the chart, a soft-preference score, and links to a printable PDF, place cards and Excel. Same seed gives the same chart; change seed to reshuffle. Each call saves new PDF and Excel files (which include the names) on the plugin server for 1 hour (private download links), then deletes them. Rosters are not saved. Does not seat stadiums, theaters or airplanes.

aisle_breaks_adjacency.description: Classroom pairs: true if the aisle between desk pairs separates students, so the seat across the aisle does not count as beside. Default false (across the aisle counts as beside).

columns.description: Classroom: desks per row (rows), desk pairs per row (pairs), or groups per row (groups), e.g. 6.

escort_sort.description: Events: sort the alphabetical escort card list by last_name (default) or first_name.

front_rows.description: Classroom: how many rows count as the front for needs_front_seat, e.g. 1 (default).

group_count.description: Classroom groups layout: number of groups, e.g. 7. Default: just enough for everyone.

group_size.description: Classroom groups layout: students per group, e.g. 4 (default).

head_table_seats.description: Events shorthand: add a long head table with this many seats for VIP guests, e.g. 10.

keep_apart.description: Hard rule: people who must not sit next to each other (classroom: not beside, in front, behind or diagonal, nor in the same group; in pairs the seat across the aisle counts as beside unless aisle_breaks_adjacency is true; events: not at the same table). Each inner list is one rule, e.g. [["Ben","Eli"]].

keep_together.description: Hard rule: people who must sit next to each other (classroom) or at the same table (events). Each inner list is one rule, e.g. [["Ann Lee","Bob Lee"]].

kids_table_seats.description: Events shorthand: add a kids table with this many seats for guests marked child, e.g. 8.

label_rule.description: How to use labels: mix (spread each label across groups and neighbours; the classroom default), group (seat the same label together, e.g. college friends; the event default), or ignore.

layout.description: Classroom desk layout: rows (single desks, default), pairs (desks in twos), or groups (pods/tables of group_size).

mode.description: classroom for a teacher's seating chart of desks; event for a wedding, party, banquet or gala with tables.

people.description: The students or guests: plain names ("Ava Martinez") or objects with flags, e.g. {"name":"Cara Diaz","needs_front_seat":true}. Leave out when a roster file is attached.

child.description: Events only: true for a child who sits at the kids table when there is one.

label.description: Optional group label to mix or group by, e.g. B (reading level), Bride's side, or Team Red.

name.description: Name as it should print, e.g. Ava Martinez.

needs_front_seat.description: Classroom only: true if the student needs a front seat. Do not ask for or pass a reason.

party.description: Events only: household or party. Everyone in the same party sits at the same table, e.g. Martinez family.

vip.description: Events only: true to seat this guest at the head table, e.g. the couple and the wedding party.

prefer_apart.description: Soft preference: try to keep these people apart; scored, not forced. Each inner list is one rule, e.g. [["Uncle Joe","Aunt Sue"]].

prefer_together.description: Soft preference: try to seat these people together; scored, not forced. Each inner list is one rule, e.g. [["Mia","Zoe"]].

previous_seat_order.description: Classroom rotation: last chart's seat_order from this tool (names by seat number, "" for empty desks). The new chart avoids last time's neighbours and desks.

roster_file.description: Optional class roster or guest list as CSV, TSV or Excel .xlsx with a header row: a Name column (or First/Last), and optional Party/Household, Group/Label, Front seat, VIP, Child, RSVP, Keep apart (names) and Table columns, e.g. guests.xlsx.

download_url.description: Temporary download link for the file, supplied by ChatGPT.

file_name.description: Original file name if known, e.g. statement.pdf.

mime_type.description: Media type if known, e.g. application/pdf.

rows.description: Classroom rows/pairs: number of rows from the front, e.g. 5.

seats_per_table.description: Events shorthand: seats per regular table, e.g. 8 (default) or 10.

seed.description: Shuffle number, e.g. 1 (default). The same inputs and seed give the same chart; use another number to reshuffle.

table_count.description: Events shorthand: number of regular guest tables, e.g. 12. Default: just enough.

count.description: How many tables of this kind, e.g. 10.

seats.description: Seats at each of these tables, e.g. 8.

type.description: guest (default), head (for VIP guests only) or kids (for children only).

title.description: Title printed on the chart, e.g. Period 3 - Room 114, or Lee & Park Wedding.

name: generate_seating_chart
title: Generate seating chart
